title: Brandon Flowers Performs Songs from ‘THRASHER’ Live on Outlaw Country
summary: Listen to the full mini-concert featuring performances of “An American Dream” and more.
body_markdown:
Brandon Flowers is exploring a new sound.


[The Killers](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/the-killers) frontman made his foray into country and Americana with the release of his third solo album, *THRASHER* . Brandon stopped by SiriusXM’s New York City studio for an exclusive performance debuting on SiriusXM’s[Outlaw Country (Ch. 62)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/outlaw-country) on Thursday, October 22.


[Brandon Flowers Inside Outlaws Mini-Concert Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogBrandonFlowersMiniConcertOutlawCountry)


During his mini-concert, Brandon performed “An American Dream” and “Tiger’s Blood,” plus a cover of The Jim Carroll Band’s 1980 song “People Who Died.” Brandon’s session comes after he hosted a guest DJ set on SiriusXM’s Outlaw Country, where he highlighted the country and Americana classics that inspired his latest album.


Listen to Brandon’s *Outlaw Sessions* mini-concert on Outlaw Country (Ch. 62) starting October 22 at 8pm ET on car radios and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogBrandonFlowersMiniConcertOutlawCountry) .


In the meantime, watch Brandon’s rendition of “People Who Died” above.
